entities.summary: Mohamedia Palace was a palace of the Tunisian Beys, in the town of Mohamedia, Tunisia. It was constructed as a retreat from the capital, Tunis, in the first half of the 19th century, but was already abandoned in the second half. Today, the palace is in ruins.
